stem: Coach Wilson calls Teresa's mother before the tryout most likely to —

options.label: F
options.text: inform her that Teresa's tryout is probably going to be unsuccessful

options.label: G
options.text: tell her that Teresa will have to adjust to working with a new coach

options.label: H
options.text: persuade Teresa's mother to talk Teresa out of attending the tryout

options.label: J
options.text: give Teresa's mother directions to the training facility in Grand Prairie
